integrity: The algebraic proof is reproduced in RESULT.md and computational checks in verify.py; numerical samples are not treated as proof of infinitely many iterations. No authorship or independent expert validation is claimed.

title: Tangential cubic coupling gives a sharp active-set capture threshold for SOS-convex cubic Newton steps
